description: Facebook posts API for AI agents: send the URL of a public Facebook page and get its most recent posts as JSON: text, time, reaction, comment and share counts, video views and the breakdown of reactions. Up to 20 posts per call; pay per post in stablecoins. A page with no readable posts is not charged; posts you paid for but did not get are refunded.

limit.description: number of posts wanted, 1 to 20 (default 5). A larger value is lowered to 20 and 0 or a negative one means the default; the quote follows the value used.

url.description: URL of a public Facebook page, e.g. https://www.facebook.com/nasa/

name: facebook-posts
title: Recent posts of a Facebook page
